routes.label: Bound the area by cosine laws and construct a tangential extremizer

changes.rationale: The complete maximum-area route proves the upper bound for every convex quadrilateral containing a disk, constructs a tangential attaining quadrilateral, and separately excludes concave improvement. First consider a convex quadrilateral. If a disk of radius r fits inside it, splitting at the disk center gives K=(1/2)*sum(side_i*distance_i)>=21r. Put A,C for the opposite angles at sides (14,12) and (9,7). Applying the cosine law to the common diagonal gives 168 cos A-63 cos C=105. Right-triangle altitudes give 2K=168 sin A+63 sin C. The vector (105,2K)=168(cos A,sin A)+63(-cos C,sin C) has norm at most 231 by Cauchy-Schwarz and sin^2+cos^2=1. Therefore (2K)^2<=231^2-105^2=42336, so K<=42sqrt(6) and r<=2sqrt(6). Equality is constructible: use a radius sqrt(24) circle with successive vertex tangent lengths 8,6,3,4. Each positive half-angle is determined by its right-triangle ratio r/t. Opposite tangent-length products both equal r^2, so opposite half-angles are complementary; the four exterior turns sum to 2pi and define a convex tangent quadrilateral with sides 14,9,7,12. It is cyclic and attains both equalities. Concave quadrilaterals cannot improve the bound: their convex hull is a triangle. If the concave vertex is A,B or D, the hull retains two sides with shorter one 7,7 or 9, and triangle inradius < half that shorter side, at most 4.5<sqrt(24). If C is concave the hull has sides 12,14,t with 2<t<16. Put x=(26-t)/2, so 5<x<12. Heron and K=r*s give r_hull^2-24=[x^3-26x^2+192x-624]/(26-x). The numerator equals (x-16/3)^2*(x-46/3)-5072/27<0 throughout the interval. Thus no concave hull can hold a larger disk. The maximum is 2sqrt(6). The previously retained tangent-length-quadratic route is withdrawn as an incomplete standalone global proof: its four-tangency assumption, largest-contained-disk reduction, concave exclusion, and arbitrary half-angle identity are not established by that route.

records.reason: Root approves withdrawing the incomplete tangent-only route and retaining the independently complete area bound, attaining construction, and concave exclusion. Preserve original proof history; apply after the conditional F cosine-route mapping.
